expectations.text: Explains the rule extends Entity List/MEU List license requirements to entities 50 percent or more owned, directly or indirectly, individually or in aggregate, by listed parties (OFAC-style ownership standard)
expectations.evidence: "Entity List and MEU List license requirements (Part 744, Supplements 4 and 7) now also apply to any entity that is 50 percent or more owned, directly or indirectly, individually or in the aggregate... The ownership standard is OFAC-style."

expectations.text: Cites the origin rule: BIS interim final rule published September 30, 2025 (90 FR 47201)
States the rule is NOT currently in effect: stayed since November 10, 2025 (90 FR 50857)
expectations.evidence: "No. The rule is stayed. 90 FR 50857 (effective November 10, 2025) suspended the rule for one year"

expectations.text: States the stay was extended to January 10, 2027 by a BIS rule effective November 9, 2026 (FR Doc 2026-22793), so it does not snap back on November 10, 2026
expectations.evidence: "FR Doc 2026-22793 (filed November 5, 2026, effective November 9, 2026) extends the suspension to January 10, 2027."

expectations.text: Advises completing ownership screening of counterparties tied to listed entities before January 10, 2027
expectations.evidence: "Treat January 10, 2027 as a hard cutoff. Build and test the controls now" plus Priority 1 ownership-based screening and Priority 2 back-screening of counterparties.
